say.variants.tv_reminisce_open: Seeing an old TV still sitting there hits strange, {addressee.name}. Miss lazy nights on the couch.
Hard to believe I used to complain nothing was on TV, {addressee.name}.
Sometimes I miss catching a late-night show with actual noise in the room, {addressee.name}.
say.variants.tv_reminisce_reply: Yeah, {addressee.name}, feels like a lifetime ago when that was our biggest worry.
Same here, {addressee.name}. Funny how quiet houses make you miss commercials.
Maybe once we're settled safely we can hook one up to a generator, {addressee.name}.
say.variants.tv_power_out_open: Dead screen and dark tubes, {addressee.name}. Without the grid, that TV's just furniture.
Power's out for good, {addressee.name}. Even if anything's broadcasting, nothing lights up here.
Another quiet box collecting dust without power, {addressee.name}.
say.variants.tv_power_out_reply: Feels eerie seeing every screen dead like that, {addressee.name}.
Nothing left on the air anyway, {addressee.name}, unless we wire a generator to tapes.
At least it won't draw any undead while it's dead, {addressee.name}.
